allot.subject: Updates
allot.text: SML Mahindra Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Letter Of Offer For Rights Issue Of Equity Shares.

allot.subject: Rights Issue
allot.text: Pursuant to the above and the in-principle approval received from National Stock Exchange of India Limited ( NSE ) and BSE Limited ( BSE , and together with NSE, the  Stock Exchanges ) vide their letters, dated 16th November, 2026 and 16th November, 2026, respectively, for the proposed Rights Issue of the Company, we inform you that the Board of Directors of the Company has, at its meeting held today, i.e.16th November 2026, inter alia, considered and approved the terms of the Rights Issue

allot.subject: Press Release
allot.text: SML Mahindra Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 16, 2026, titled "SML Mahindra to raise upto Rs. 1450 crore through Rights Issue ".

allot.subject: Rights Issue
allot.text: SML Mahindra Limited has informed the Exchange that Board of Directors at its meeting held on November 16, 2026, has decided to issue equity shares on rights basis in the ratio of 2 : 7, i.e 2 Equity Shares for every 7 Equity Shares held. Rights Issue Price is Rs. 3506 per share.

allot.subject: Rights Issue
allot.text: SML Mahindra Limited has informed the Exchange that Board of Directors at its meeting held on November 06, 2026, has decided to issue equity shares on rights basis.
